Monster Rounds.desc: +25% Weapon Damage vs. NPCs, +25% Bullet Resist vs. NPCs, +1 Out of Combat Regen

Cultist Sacrifice.desc: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

Tesla Bullets.desc: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

Capacitor.desc: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy. Launch a projectile that deals Spirit Icondamage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.

Hollow Point.desc: When you are above 65% health, deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist.

Opening Rounds.desc: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health.

Melee Lifesteal.desc: Your next Melee attack heals you.

Rebuttal.desc: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

Counterspell.desc: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items. On a successful spell parry Heal and gain Move Speed and Spirit.

Weighted Shots.desc: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

Close Quarters.desc: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

Long Range.desc: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

Slowing Bullets.desc: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

Inhibitor.desc: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.

Spirit Shredder.desc: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

Heroic Aura.desc: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units. Provides Move Speed and Fire Rate to you and nearby allies. Minions get double value.

Silence Wave.desc: Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage.

Silencer.desc: Your bullets reduce the target's outgoing spirit damage. Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10ss after silence expires.

Berserker.desc: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.

Frenzy.desc: While you are below 50% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.

Siphon Bullets.desc: Your bullets temporarily steal Max HP from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.

Headshot Booster.desc: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals Bullet Damage.

Weakening Headshot.desc: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.

Sharpshooter.desc: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

Headhunter.desc: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals Bullet Damage, Heal you, and briefly grants Move Speed.

Spirit Rend.desc: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them. Landing headshots against the target reduces their Spirit Resist further.

Crippling Headshot.desc: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet, Spirit Resist, and Incoming Healing.

Mystic Shot.desc: Your next bullet deals bonus Spirit Damage.

Lucky Shot.desc: Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit.

Point Blank.desc: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.

Toxic Bullets.desc: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.

Ricochet.desc: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

Bullet Lifesteal.desc: +13% Bullet Lifesteal, +90 Bonus Health, +6% Weapon Damage

Debuff Reducer.desc: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.

Dispel Magic.desc: Purge all non-ultimate negative effects currently applied to you. If any effects were removed, heal yourself and gain a move speed bonus.

Spirit Resilience.desc: When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.

Bullet Resilience.desc: When below 50% health, gain additional Bullet Resist.

Healing Booster.desc: Increases the effectiveness of your healing.

Fortitude.desc: After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen. When you are above 75% health, you have bonus Move Speed.

Leech.desc: +28% Spirit Lifesteal, +28% Bullet Lifesteal, +180 Bonus Health, +12% Weapon Damage, +12 Spirit Power

Sprint Boots.desc: +2m Sprint Speed, +2 Out of Combat Regen

Trophy Collector.desc: Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.

Enduring Speed.desc: Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.

Stamina Mastery.desc: Allows an additional use of Air Jump or Air Dash before landing.

Hunter's Aura.desc: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.

Grit.desc: Gain a Barrier for a short duration.

Weapon Shielding.desc: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant Weapon Damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

Spirit Shielding.desc: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant Spirit Damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

Battle Vest.desc: While you are above 65% health, gain Weapon Damage and Fire Rate.

Enchanter's Emblem.desc: While you are above 65% health, gain bonus Spirit and Cooldown Reduction.

Mystic Regeneration.desc: Dealing Spirit Damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus Regen. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

Improved Spirit.desc: +18 Spirit Power, +1.5 Out of Combat Regen

Spiritual Overflow.desc: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.

Return Fire.desc: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

Greater Expansion.desc: Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.

Mystic Expansion.desc: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius.

Extra Charge.desc: +1 Bonus Ability Charges, +7 Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

Spirit Lifesteal.desc: +13% Spirit Lifesteal, +90 Bonus Health, +6 Spirit Power

Bullet Resist Shredder.desc: Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal Spirit Damage.

Mystic Reverb.desc: Imbue an ability with Lifesteal and to apply slow on a hit target and deal an additional percentage of the damage dealt to enemies around the target after a short delay.

Mystic Burst.desc: Charges up over time with Bonus Spirit Damage, causing abilities dealing more than 80 damage to deal additional damage.

Tankbuster.desc: Charges up over time with Bonus Spirit Damage, causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.

Mystic Vulnerability.desc: When an enemy takes Spirit Damage, they have their Spirit Resist reduced.

Healbane.desc: Your Spirit Damage reduces the enemy's Incoming Healing. If an enemy hero dies under this effect, you receive a large heal.

Mystic Slow.desc: When the target takes Spirit Damage, they have their Move Speed reduced.

Escalating Exposure.desc: Dealing Spirit Damage applies a stacking Spirit Amp that increases your Spirit Damage to the target.

Rapid Recharge.desc: +2 Bonus Ability Charges, +30% Faster Time Between Charges, +14% Cooldown Reduction For Charged Abilities, +14 Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

Omnicharge Signet.desc: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.

Compress Cooldown.desc: Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown.

Superior Cooldown.desc: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

Transcendent Cooldown.desc: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

Slowing Hex.desc: Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities.

Spirit Sap.desc: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

Focus Lens.desc: Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.

Rusted Barrel.desc: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.

Disarming Hex.desc: Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist.

Rescue Beam.desc: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

Decay.desc: Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health. Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

Scourge.desc: Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals Spirit Icondamage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced. Can be self cast.

Knockdown.desc: Apply a Stun after 2ss. Stun duration is increased against airborne targets.

Phantom Strike.desc: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.

Warp Stone.desc: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.

Vortex Web.desc: Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex.

Refresher.desc: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.

Echo Shard.desc: Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability. This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability.

Torment Pulse.desc: Periodically deals Spirit Damage to the closest two enemies nearby.

Cheat Death.desc: When you would take lethal damage, instead become temporarily death immune and remove all non-stun debuffs. While death immune, you deal reduced damage and have reduced healing.

Shadow Weave.desc: Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed. Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.

Restorative Locket.desc: When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack. Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.

Healing Rite.desc: Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.

Shrink Ray.desc: Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.

Infuser.desc: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power.

Guardian Ward.desc: Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed.

Divine Barrier.desc: Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed.

Alchemical Fire.desc: Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing Spirit Damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist. 50% less effective vs non-heroes.

Blood Tribute.desc: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve Fire Rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.

Fleetfoot.desc: Removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting. Gain bonus Move Speed and Slow Resistance.

Kinetic Dash.desc: When you Dash-Jump you gain Fire Rate and bonus Ammo until your next reload. Lasts up to 7ss.

Arcane Surge.desc: After you Dash-Jump, the next ability you use within s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power.

Unstoppable.desc: Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm. Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

Colossus.desc: Grow larger in size, gaining Bullet Resist, Spirit Resist, and Melee Damage. Nearby enemies suffer from Slow and have reduced dash speed.

Cold Front.desc: Release an expanding ice blast that deals Spirit Damage and Slows targets it hits.

Arctic Blast.desc: Release an expanding ice blast that deals Spirit Damage, Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits. Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

Ethereal Shift.desc: Instantly enter a void state and become Invulnerable for a short duration. Afterwards, gain a variety of temporary buffs:

Cursed Relic.desc: Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming, and preventing item usage. Removes all non-ultimate buffs. Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration.

Duration Extender.desc: Imbue an ability to increase its Duration.

Superior Duration.desc: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

Glass Cannon.desc: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

Fury Trance.desc: Grants Fire Rate, Spirit Resistance and Move Speed, and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration.

Vampiric Burst.desc: Grants Lifesteal, Fire Rate, and Ammo. This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

Lifestrike.desc: Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount.

Spirit Strike.desc: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra Spirit Damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist.

Spirit Snatch.desc: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra Spirit Damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

Melee Charge.desc: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

Crushing Fists.desc: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage. Your Melee Damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks. If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.

Diviner's Kevlar.desc: Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.

Radiant Regeneration.desc: Dealing Spirit Damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus Regen. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes. Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.

Boundless Spirit.desc: +15% Spirit Power, +30 Spirit Power, +75 Bonus Health, +4 Out of Combat Regen

Burst Fire.desc: Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits an enemy hero.

Extra Regen.desc: +2.5 Health Regen, +1.5 Out of Combat Regen

Surge of Power.desc: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

Suppressor.desc: When you deal Spirit Damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.

Quicksilver Reload.desc: Your imbued ability charges up over time with Bonus Spirit Damage, Fire Rate, and reloads bullets on use.

Mercurial Magnum.desc: Your imbued ability charges up over time with Bonus Spirit Damage, Fire Rate, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal Bonus Spirit Damage based on your Spirit Power.

Intensifying Magazine.desc: Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.

Escalating Resilience.desc: Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit an enemy hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.

Veil Walker.desc: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.

Reactive Barrier.desc: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.

Indomitable.desc: The next Stun, Chain, Immobilize, Sleep or Silence is automatically cleansed. When this happens, you gain a barrier and all your ability cooldowns get reduced by 20s%.

Restorative Shot.desc: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

Split Shot.desc: Make your weapon fire multishot. Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus.

Active Reload.desc: While reloading, pressing [Reload] during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.

Magic Carpet.desc: Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet.

Spirit Burn.desc: Dealing significant Spirit Damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.

Lightning Scroll.desc: Damage from your ultimate applies a Stun and deals Bonus Spirit Damage after a short delay.  Mystic Slow effects

Witchmail.desc: Taking heavy hits of Spirit Damage from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown.

Healing Tempo.desc: Applying Heal to yourself or an ally grants the target Fire Rate and Move Speed.

Armor Piercer.desc: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

Infinite Rounds.desc: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance. You have infinite ammo.

Plated Armor.desc: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all Weapon Damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.

Spellbreaker.desc: The next instance of high Spirit Damage you take is significantly reduced.

Juggernaut.desc: Enemies that shoot you have their Fire Rate slowed.

Spellslinger.desc: While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed.

Stalker.desc: Dealing Weapon Damage at close range opens a wound and grants you Move Speed. Wounded enemies take Spirit DPS, have reduced Bullet Resist, and are revealed through walls.

Express Shot.desc: Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.

Seraphim Wings.desc: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.

Mystical Piano.desc: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.

Nullification Burst.desc: Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.

Celestial Blessing.desc: Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.

Eternal Gift.desc: Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff. Reduces your next death's respawn timer.

Mystic Conduit.desc: Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies. Dealing significant Damage to an enemy Hero within 5s causes you to heal yourself and nearby allies.

Haunting Shot.desc: Your next bullet applies a powerful debuff reducing the enemy's damage output, healing and movement speed. It also deals Bonus Spirit Damage based on the target's current Health. The bullet is larger and penetrates through targets.

Cloak of Opportunity.desc: Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep and become Unstoppable. Also gain a Barrier and bonus Move Speed

Runed Gauntlets.desc: Pierces through parry. Every time you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.

Electric Slippers.desc: When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you.

Prism Blast.desc: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

Unstable Concoction.desc: Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50%.

Frostbite Charm.desc: Imbued ability has its Cooldown reduced and gains Spirit Power. When the ability deals damage, freeze the target and apply bonus damage.

Shadow Strike.desc: Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.

Ballistic Enchantment.desc: Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.

Recharging Rush.desc: Dealing significant Weapon Damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities.

Golden Goose Egg.desc: Hatch the egg, gaining souls and permanent buffs. The value of the egg grows the longer you hold onto it. Gain a permanent buff per 80 Souls accrued when hatched.

Majestic Leap.desc: Launch yourself high into the air and gain a Barrier. While in the air, use it again to drop down faster.
